title: The Survey of the Health of Wisconsin (SHOW) Program: An infrastructure for Advancing Population Health Sciences

evidence_spans.quote: serving as an agile resource infrastructure for ancillary studies
providing a timely and accurate picture of the health of the state residents
supports translational and multi-omics research to better understand how life experiences and exposures contribute to health disparities and aging processes

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This is a cohort and biorepository infrastructure description, not a current-report analysis of aging. Aging is mentioned only as a prospective research application.
